_source: Stat weights of specs the level-20 engine (site_build/wow_dps_sim.py) cannot play, measured with the level-60 simulator (site_build/sim60, the one behind the ranking): the spec's ranking character (best known gear, ranking talent build, raid buffs), DPS gained by one more point of each stat with the same random draws on both sides. crit/hit are per percentage point, wdps_* per +1 weapon DPS on that weapon. Regenerate with: cd site_build/sim60 && ADDON_WDPS=1 RANK_ONLY=<ranking spec> RANK_OUT=../../scratch_rank.json node ranking.mjs 180 6000, then copy the numbers of detail.weights here.
